correctness.rationale: With X_n attachment to the oldest vertex and Y_n attachment to any leaf, E[X|T]=D/2(n-1), E[Y|T]=L/2(n-1), E[XY|T]=1_{D=1}/2(n-1). The mixed product recurrence cancels the D*L terms and gives c_{n+1}-c_n=d_n l_n/(4(n-1)^2)-q_n/(2(n-1)). Exact d=(2n-3)q and l=2(n-1)/3+4q/3 yield the displayed positive increment for n>=3; gamma ratio q~1/sqrt(pi n) then gives c_n~2sqrt(n)/(3sqrt(pi)). An independent exact rational recurrence checked 158 increments. Boundary c2=c3=0 verified.
